name: metasell-ai
description: Read-only access to your Metasell sales data: calls and call analysis, CRM leads, contacts and tasks, manager performance, alerts and daily summaries.

interface.longDescription:
Metasell AI is an AI sales coaching platform for sales teams. Connect your Metasell account to ask about your own sales data in plain words: how many calls the team made yesterday, which manager's call scores dropped this week, which leads are stuck in a stage, what a customer said on their last call, or what each manager should improve.

Metasell AI reads calls and call analysis, CRM leads, contacts and tasks, manager performance, alerts and daily summaries for one business you choose, with your own access rights: a sales manager sees only their own data. Dates follow your business time zone.

The connection is read-only: it cannot create, change or delete anything, and call transcripts are not shared. You sign in with your Metasell account and can disconnect at any time from Metasell Settings → Profile → Connected AI apps.

positive.description: Team call volume and average score for yesterday
positive.prompt: How many calls did my team make yesterday, and what was the average call score?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns yesterday's call count and average call score for the business, in the business time zone.

positive.description: Weakest manager this week with coaching points
positive.prompt: Which manager had the lowest call scores this week, and what should they work on?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the manager with the lowest average score this week, gives the score and 2-3 concrete coaching points from analyzed calls.

positive.prompt: Show me yesterday's missed incoming calls.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists yesterday's missed inbound calls with time and manager, or says there were none.

positive.prompt: How many active leads are there in each pipeline stage?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of active leads and the lead count at each pipeline stage.

positive.prompt: Give me today's daily summary for the sales team.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved daily summary for today, or says that today's summary is not ready yet. It never generates a new one.

negative.description: Requests to change data are refused because the plugin is read-only
negative.prompt: Delete all leads older than one year.

negative.description: Requests to message customers are refused
negative.prompt: Send this customer an SMS saying we will call tomorrow.

negative.description: Unrelated questions do not use the plugin
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Tashkent today?

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only Metasell sales data over MCP.
